results.name: _cf_KV
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE _cf_KV (
        key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        value BLOB
      ) WITHOUT ROWID

results.name: contact_events
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE contact_events (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  nct_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('email_click', 'email_copy')),
  recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  recorded_at_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL
) WITHOUT ROWID

results.name: d1_migrations
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE "d1_migrations"(
		id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
		name       TEXT UNIQUE,
		applied_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
)

results.name: trial_contact_counts
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE trial_contact_counts (
  nct_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  email_clicks INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  email_copies INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
) WITHOUT ROWID

results.name: trial_suggestions
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE trial_suggestions (
  nct_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  categories TEXT NOT NULL,
  relevance TEXT NOT NULL,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  study_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  submitted_at TEXT NOT NULL
)
